'''Surik Varr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] member of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where he pretended to be a merchant in the [[House Traders' Circle]] in [[King's Pass]]. He informed a Republic citizen that [[House Rist]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] under [[Thorin Rist]] - also posing as merchants - plotted to assassinate a group of House Organa nobles.
